verdict.rationale: The only explicit first-party bulk capability in the evidence is importing users from a CSV file in IAM identity domains, which is a narrow, single-domain bulk operation. The CLI, SDKs, REST APIs and Terraform provider are general automation building blocks; none is documented here as offering bulk or batch actions across many items. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operations across resource types (e.g., bulk delete, move, tag or update via CLI/API/Console), evidence of bulk actions beyond user import, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
